canonical_name: Escape to the Page (creative writing workshop, run by Sondra Hall)
summary: Escape to the Page is a paid creative writing class using a 'Wild Writing' prompt technique, led by writer/teacher Sondra Hall, held at Muse Art Bar in this listing (an 8-week Monday series, $280 upfront) and separately as $35 drop-in sessions at other venues like Blind Tiger and White Horse Black Mountain. It is a commercial class taught by one instructor across multiple venues, not a fixed-membership community, despite 'writing in community' framing.

evidence.note: Our scraped data only carries AI-generated summaries describing it as a 'late-night reading hangout' with no description text, tags like 'Book Club' and 'Reading Night' but no membership language.

The live Explore Asheville page (fetched) actually describes an 8-week creative writing workshop led by Sondra Hall, $280 upfront for the series, weekly Mondays 5:30-7:30pm -- our AI summary mischaracterized it as a silent reading night.
Escape to the Page is Sondra Hall's branded creative writing class/business, using a fixed 'Wild Writing' format (read a poem, write two 25-min timed pieces, share aloud without critique).

The same 'Escape to the Page' class runs as $35 drop-in sessions at other venues (Blind Tiger, White Horse Black Mountain), confirming it is a touring paid class format rather than a single group with a fixed member roster tied to Muse Art Bar.
A genuinely group-like silent reading community exists in Asheville (Silent Book Club Asheville), but it is a separate, unrelated entity from Escape to the Page.
